description: PowerModelsDistribution.jl, published by lanl-ansi, extends PowerModels with steady-state distribution-network power flow, optimal power flow, load shedding and tap-changing formulations. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The authors say documentation lags development; supported network-feature and formulation combinations need checking. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: It is a distinct distribution-network extension of model-powermodels-jl, whose existing record describes transmission formulations.
